capabilities: Search the vault and show results as heading and list-item context trees
Show backlinks and unlinked mentions with their heading path and parent items
Fold and unfold result trees and open a note at the selected line
Filter mentions with ignored terms, ignored folders and per-note opt-out properties
Export results to a new note as nested lists (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a fork of Better Search Views; the README states it is an independent view built on the public Obsidian API.
extras: Freemium: search, backlinks, unlinked mentions and filters are free; regex, saved queries, per-note view states and export are Pro. Pro verification runs a GitHub device-flow sign-in and queries GitHub about sponsorship status; no network requests before sign-in and no note content is sent. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later; tests run on desktop only. One payment unlocks Pro across all NoteMods plugins.
problem: Obsidian's core Search and Backlinks panes show matching lines without the heading path or parent list items that give them context.

relations.evidence: No. It has no code from Better Search Views.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($15 once or $5/month) for Pro features
GitHub account for Pro sign-in and sponsorship checks

summary: Search and backlinks view that shows each result with its heading path and parent list items as a context tree.
